name: @dotfiles/opencode-security-plugin
description: Security plugin for OpenCode that filters sensitive file access using AST-based bash parsing

scripts.build: bun build src/security-filter.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm
scripts.install-to-opencode: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode/plugins/ && cp dist/security-filter.js ~/.config/opencode/plugins/agentfilter.js
